metadata.source: Virginia Tech Mid-Atlantic Aviation Partnership (MAAP), material supplied for the asset map
metadata.disclaimer: Summaries of the supplied MAAP briefing, flight-area overview, geographic files, and September 2026 Smart Airspace briefing. Import date is not an approval date. The source package does not establish current COA validity, complete conditions, or general public access.
metadata.geometry_note: Original supplied outlines, including over-water areas; no clipping, invented Blackstone circle, inferred vertical limits or waypoint import. Central Virginia is labeled draft in its source KML.
unmapped_areas: MAAP Blackstone Class D Flight Area

properties.name: MAAP Kentland Farm Flight Area
properties.boundary_status: Operator-supplied reference outline; current approval not independently checked
properties.published_size: Approximately 2.5 sq mi flight area; 1,800-acre research farm (different measures)
properties.altitude_limit: Up to 700 ft AGL, as stated in the supplied MAAP briefing
properties.aircraft_scope: Aircraft up to 1,320 lb under MAAP's described test-site approval; aircraft and mission eligibility require confirmation
properties.launch_recovery: 300-ft runway and hangar at Kentland Experimental Aerial Systems Laboratory
properties.constraints: Coordinate with MAAP. Adjacent Radford Army Ammunition Plant acreage is not included in this supplied outline and is not available by implication.
properties.coa_reference: 2024-ESA-15752-44803 (briefing reference; validity and conditions not checked)
properties.source_title: MAAP supplied flight-area and capability references
properties.access: Coordinate a project with MAAP; map display is not flight authorization

properties.name: MAAP Central Virginia Flight Area
properties.boundary_status: Source KML folder is labeled COA DRAFT 108625; provisional reference outline
properties.published_size: Approximately 4,500 sq mi in the briefing; not a measurement of the supplied polygon
properties.altitude_limit: Up to 7,000 ft MSL, as stated in the supplied MAAP briefing
properties.aircraft_scope: Aircraft up to 1,320 lb under MAAP's described test-site approval; aircraft and mission eligibility require confirmation
properties.launch_recovery: Briefing identifies a 3,000-ft runway and hangar at Crewe Airport as supporting infrastructure
properties.constraints: Supplied corridor outline skirts the Blackstone Class D area. Its draft labeling must be resolved with MAAP before operational use; airport access and current airspace approvals are separate.
properties.coa_reference: 2024-ESA-15755-44803 (briefing reference; validity and conditions not checked)
properties.source_title: MAAP supplied flight-area and capability references
properties.access: Coordinate a project with MAAP; map display is not flight authorization

properties.name: MAAP Eastern Shore Offshore Flight Area
properties.boundary_status: Operator-supplied reference outline; current approval not independently checked
properties.published_size: Approximately 990 sq mi in the briefing; not a measurement of the supplied polygon
properties.altitude_limit: Up to 3,000 ft MSL, as stated in the supplied MAAP briefing
properties.aircraft_scope: Aircraft up to 1,320 lb under MAAP's described test-site approval; aircraft and mission eligibility require confirmation
properties.launch_recovery: Accomack County Airport is the described base of operations; overview lists a 5,000-ft runway
properties.constraints: Over-water and warning-area research environment adjoining R-6609. Briefing describes different chase-aircraft provisions within the warning area; obtain the actual conditions from MAAP before planning a flight.
